momondo_one_star_source_default.searchQuery: site:momondo.com Bangkok Thailand 1-star hotel average nightly price
momondo_one_star_source_default.reason: The Momondo-restricted result identified the Bangkok hotel page but did not expose an exact city-wide 1-star average in the returned snippet. Other returned snippets were generic hotel, hostel, or property results and were rejected.

skyscanner_one_star_explicit_two_adults.searchQuery: site:skyscanner.com Bangkok Thailand 1-star hotel average nightly price 2 adults 1 room
skyscanner_one_star_explicit_two_adults.reason: The Skyscanner result identified Bangkok and explicitly showed 2 adults/1 room, but the snippet supplied only a 3-star average and all-hotel prices, not a 1-star class price. It was rejected.

expedia_one_star_explicit_two_adults.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Bangkok Thailand 1-star hotel average nightly price 2 adults 1 room
expedia_one_star_explicit_two_adults.reason: The Expedia result identified Bangkok and stated a two-adult one-room basis, but its city-wide page listed no 1-star class trend or numeric 1-star average. A returned 1-star Ratchadaphisek page was district-only and rejected.
